calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS customer_count
FROM dim_member m
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere' AND m.is_current = TRUE

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.city, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_store s
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND m.is_current = TRUE
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.city
ORDER BY s.store_id
